claims.statement: The proposed residual Gr^W_24 H^{23}(M_{5,7};H) with H the weight-one standard symplectic variation is correct as the pure weight-24 contribution of the weight-one graded piece of forgetful R^1 (Leray bidegree (23,1); wt 23+1=24; H^{24}(M_{5,7})=0 by vcd 4g-4+n=23), but is formulated incompletely as the sole residual: forgetful R^1 is mixed of weights 1 and 2, so the weight-two puncture quotient is omitted, and the standard global residual of SRC-0002 Lemma 3.1 is local systems of weight 8 on M_5 rather than a single weight-1 system on M_{5,7}. The residual was not formulated with an incorrect degree or Tate weight for the weight-one summand.

M_{5,n} has the CKgP and A^*=R^* for all n<=c(5)=7; hence W_k H^k(M_{5,7}) equals the tautological pure-weight subspace (and vanishes for odd k). This is ordinary-coefficient algebraicity/Tate, not a theorem about H^*(M_{5,7};V) for nontrivial symplectic V.

summary: For (g,n)=(5,8) one has d=20, so the open input is W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{5,8}) ≅ W_{24}H^{24}(M_{5,8})(20) with untwisted ordinary Tate type Q(-12). Under the forgetful map M_{5,8}→M_{5,7}, vcd(M_{5,7})=4·5-4+7=23 kills H^{24}(M_{5,7}), so the only Leray contribution to degree 24 is H^{23}(M_{5,7};R^1). The fibre is a 7-punctured genus-five curve, so R^1 is mixed of weights 1 and 2: Gr^W_1 is the standard symplectic local system V of rank 10 (pullback of R^1 of the universal compact genus-five curve), while Gr^W_2 is the weight-two puncture quotient of rank 6. Thus Gr^W_24 H^{23}(M_{5,7};V) is the correct pure weight-24 residual from the weight-one summand (degree 23, variation weight 1, total weight 24), but the proposed residual is incomplete if taken as the full residual: it omits possible pure-weight-24 contributions from the weight-two puncture local system through mixed base cohomology, and the literature's global residual (SRC-0002 Lemma 3.1) is instead ⊕_{|λ|=8} W_{24}H^{16}(M_5,V_λ). No cited theorem computes, forces Tate type for, or proves vanishing of Gr^W_24 H^{23}(M_{5,7};V). Closest established results: M_{5,7} has CKgP so ordinary W_k H^k(M_{5,7}) is tautological/Tate (insufficient for nontrivial local systems); compact even cohomology is pure Tate through degree 14 while degree 16 remains open as of the May 2026 survey.
unresolved: No locator-level computation or vanishing/Tate theorem for Gr^W_24 H^{23}(M_{5,7};V) with V the weight-one standard symplectic local system.
Full pure-weight-24 forgetful residual may also involve the weight-two puncture local system on M_{5,7}; not separated in the proposed group.
Alternative residual ⊕_{|λ|=8} W_{24}H^{16}(M_5,V_λ) of Lemma 3.1 likewise uncomputed in the supplied corpus.
Compact/open degree-16 pure Tate for (5,8) remains open through the 2026-05-19 survey date.
